evals.name: dry-run-no-changes
evals.prompt: Run /prod-readiness --dry-run on a project with 2 lint warnings and 1 failing test. Build passes.
evals.expected_output: All phases run, findings reported, no files edited, no commits, verdict printed, /git-ship not invoked.
assertions: Runs all phases (build, lint, audit, test, simplify, validation, git)
Makes NO edits to any source files

evals.name: no-ship-build-failure
evals.prompt: Run /prod-readiness on a project with a compile error that persists after 2 fix attempts.
evals.expected_output: Attempts 2 fixes, stops with NO-SHIP verdict. No subsequent phases run.
assertions: Attempts to fix build errors up to 2 iterations
After 2 failed fix attempts, stops and reports NO-SHIP
Does NOT run subsequent phases (lint, test, etc.)
Prints VERDICT: NO-SHIP with the build failure as the blocking reason

evals.name: clear-to-ship-auto
evals.prompt: Run /prod-readiness --ship on a clean project. Build passes, no lint errors, tests green, no secrets, no audit findings.
evals.expected_output: All phases pass. CLEAR TO SHIP verdict. Automatically invokes /git-ship.
assertions: Automatically invokes /git-ship without prompting the user

evals.name: ship-with-caution-confirmation
evals.prompt: Run /prod-readiness --ship on a project with 2 unfixed High audit findings. Build passes, tests green.
evals.expected_output: SHIP WITH CAUTION verdict. Prints warnings and asks for confirmation before shipping.
assertions: Prints VERDICT: SHIP WITH CAUTION with warnings listed
Asks 'Ship with these warnings? (yes/no)' and WAITS for user response
Does NOT auto-invoke /git-ship before user confirms
If user says no: stops cleanly
